messages:
kevin huang: Heads-up: I'm assembling an "audit onboarding" checklist + a small customer sample pack so customers can validate our audit events. Need eyes on schema changes, KMS wording, and the customer-facing comms. Goal: preview in docs and send to a few beta customers next Tue. @rachel ortiz @samir patel

rachel ortiz: Nice — what's the pack going to contain?

kevin huang: Plan: - short changelog summary (fields added/removed) - curated sample payloads (RBAC, KMS access, session lifecycle) - tiny validation scripts (jq + python) - SIEM mapping examples (Splunk, ELK) - comms blurb + FAQ

samir patel: SGTM. Recommend adding a mapping matrix to common SIEM fields and a sample query per vendor. Also include retention/forwarding notes for Private deployments.

kevin huang: Agreed. Draft sample payload below — thinking event name = \"audit.session.start\" for now. Any objections?

```
{
  "event_id": "evt_01GXZ2Q7VY8K8ZQ1A0B2C3D",
  "event_type": "audit.session.start",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T15:22:10Z",
  "principal_id": "user_789",
  "principal_role": "platform_admin",
  "target_resource": "dedicated-pool-12",
  "action": "start_session",
  "outcome": "success",
  "metadata": {
    "ip": "203.0.113.45",
    "region": "us-west-2",
    "request_id": "req_3456"
  }
}
```

rachel ortiz: Looks good. Two nits: 1) Use ISO8601 with TZ (you already have that, nice). 2) change actor_id -> principal_id for consistency with other events (so +1 for your field name). Also call out that KMS events only contain key_reference, never key material.

kevin huang: Good catches. We'll explicitly add a sentence: \"KMS events only include key_reference and operation metadata; no plaintext key material or key material-derived secrets are logged.\"

sec-ci-bot: Deploy preview for docs: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/audit-onboarding -> build #2467 succeeded :white_check_mark:

samir patel: For the SIEM pack I'll draft Splunk/ELK queries that map audit.session.start -> host.user, event.action, etc. Also will add a short retention note: \"Private deployments may configure longer local retention; hosted customers see default 90d unless on enterprise plan.\"

kevin huang: Draft customer-facing blurb for review: \"We are expanding audit coverage to include richer RBAC events, KMS access operations (key_reference only), and dedicated-deployment lifecycle events. No secrets or key material will be logged. Customers can validate events using the sample pack in our docs and run the included scripts to map to their SIEM. Contact support or your AM if you want a private preview.\" Thoughts?

rachel ortiz: LGTM. For the changelog snippet, add: \"Added fields: event_type, principal_role, request_id; renamed actor_id -> principal_id.\"

kevin huang: I'll push the docs draft and changelog later tonight. @samir patel can you review the SIEM queries and sample Splunk dashboard widget? Need final sign-off by EOD Monday so we can tag product/comms.

samir patel: On it — I'll add comments to the PR by tomorrow AM and include a sample Splunk search + visualization.

kevin huang: Thanks — once we have sign-off I'll prepare the customer-preview email and the docs announcement. Ending checklist: 1) PR with sample pack + scripts 2) changelog entry 3) SIEM mapping doc 4) comms blurb + FAQ 5) internal runbook for incident triage on audit events

rachel ortiz: Perfect. Ping me for QA on sample payloads.

kevin huang: Will do — thanks everyone!
